name: Shopify
outlook:
What Shopify says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: revenue, gross profit and costsFor the fourth quarter of 2026, we expect: • Revenue to grow at a low-thirties percentage rate on a year-over-year basis; • Gross profit dollars to grow at a high-twenties percentage rate on a year-over-year basis; • Operating expenses as a percentage of revenue to be 29% to 30%; • Stock-based compensation to be $155 million; and • Free cash flow margin to be consistent with the fourth quarter of 2025.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 3, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
